title: Degraded recommendations
description: Elevated latency on recommendation-service (p95 5.5s) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: A traffic surge (~1.7x normal) exceeded the capacity of the recommendation-service connection pool (max 15); requests waited for connections until timeout.
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in recommendation-service logs
recommendation-service p95 latency rises from ~96ms to ~5.5s
recommendation-service memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
request_rate on recommendation-service rises ~1.8x before saturation
resolution: Scaled out recommendation-service, raised the pool size within the database max_connections budget and added rate limiting for campaign traffic.
